findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service_details, get_order_status · Private data: get_print_quote, update_print_quote, get_service_details, check_printability, get_design_guidance, quote_from_link, get_order_status, reorder_from_order, combine_quotes · Public sink: get_print_quote, get_service_details, check_printability, get_order_status, reorder_from_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service_details, get_order_status · Private data: get_print_quote, update_print_quote, get_service_details, check_printability, get_design_guidance, quote_from_link, get_order_status, reorder_from_order, combine_quotes · Public sink: get_print_quote, get_service_details, check_printability, get_order_status, reorder_from_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_print_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
